dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Seattle Seahawks Prepare for Week 12 Division Battle Against 8-1 49ers
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: Sitting at 6-4 following their bye week under head coach Mike Macdonald, Seattle faces a critical Week 12 road test against the 8-1 San Francisco 49ers. The Seahawks enter missing key starters, including quarterback Sam Darnold and tackle Charles Cross, while holding a 46.5% playoff berth projection.
bullets: Seattle enters Week 12 leading the NFL in pass defense (149.4 yards allowed per game) and tackles for loss (6.50 per game), though offensive coordinator Brian Fleury must navigate a rushing attack ranking #28 in EPA (-3.43) as evaluated by [NFL Nation](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50520404/nfl-offensive-coordinators-playcallers-midseason-report).

Defensive tackle Jarran Reed (questionable, toe) anchored Seattle's defensive front during the Week 10 road win over Las Vegas prior to the bye week, documented by [seahawks.com Video](https://www.seahawks.com/video/jarran-reed-mic-d-up-for-week-10-win-at-the-las-vegas-raiders-seattle-seahawks).

Tactical film review from back-to-back victories entering the bye highlights safety Nick Emmanwori's expanding role inside defensive coordinator Aden Durde's scheme, noted by [seahawks.com Video](https://www.seahawks.com/video/power-of-the-70-the-sound-of-the-seahawks-s5-ep-5-presented-by-t-mobile) and reporter [Michael-Shawn Dugar](https://bsky.app/profile/mikedugar.bsky.social/post/3n2mvoxf7sk2b).

With starting quarterback Sam Darnold ruled out due to a quadriceps injury alongside offensive linemen Charles Cross and Quenton Nelson, Drew Lock takes over under center, according to the [seahawks.com Official](https://www.seahawks.com/news/seahawks-mailbag-sam-darnold-s-return-devon-witherspoon-s-physicality-more) report.
